1580-4871-5670-6578.easyPrerequisites:

When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Sephiroth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.

When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize

Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.

Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2638-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control

Repeat.

You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue

Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
